```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Purpose:**
Validates the gene signature used in downstream analyses 

**Inputs:**
1. FOXD3 Gene Signatures
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

2. A375 Knock Out dataset - DESeq2 Object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

3. Tiago et al dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

4. Yang et al. dataset - Seurat object
    Generated by: `02_scRNAseq_processing.RMD`

5. DuBose et al dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

6. Celeste et al dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`
    
    
**Manuscript Outputs:**
- Figure 1E-1H - gene signature validation across internal and external datasets
- Figure SXX 

# Set up necessary background


## Libraries
```{r Libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(here)
  library(ggvenn)
  library(GSEABase)
  library(GSVA)
  library(limma)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(rstatix)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyverse)
})
```

## Set File Locations

```{r}
resultsDir1 <- here("data", "data_objects")
resultsDir2 <- here("data", "gene_sig")
resultsDir3 <- here("data", "gene_val")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir3)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir3, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## Import the FOXD3 Gene Signature

```{r geneSets}
geneSets <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "241213_OE_Combined.gmt"))

geneSets_HUGO <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "241213_OE_Combined_HUGO.gmt"))
```

# Internal Validation 

## Tiago et al Dataset
DESeqDataSet object used as the starting point for this analysis. The object was provided by a member of our laboratory and was generated from GSE228600. Please add to the data folder with the rest of the dataobjects in the format "tiago.RDS" to ensure the code works

```{r}

dds_tiago <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_tiago.rds"))

# check if there are values after decimal & remove 
if (any(grepl("\\.", rownames(dds_tiago)))) {
  rownames(dds_tiago) <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(dds_tiago))
  message("Gene versions stripped successfully.")
} else {
  message("No decimals found.")
}

ntcts <- counts(dds_tiago,normalized = TRUE)
  
# prep expression data
expPlusGSVA = log10(ntcts + 1)
expPlusGSVA = distinct(as.data.frame(ntcts),.keep_all=FALSE)
  
# run gsva
gbmPar <- gsvaParam(as.matrix(expPlusGSVA), geneSets, maxDiff=FALSE)
gbm_es <- gsva(gbmPar)
NES_data <- gbm_es
  
  
# set desired column orders
col_order <- c("A2058_DMSO_1","A2058_DMSO_2","A2058_DMSO_3",
                 "A2058_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_1","A2058_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_2","A2058_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_3",
                 "WM793_DMSO_1","WM793_DMSO_2","WM793_DMSO_3", 
                 "WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_1","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_2","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_3")
  
# get just the desired columns in the correct order
NES_data2 <- NES_data[,col_order]
  
# update the column names
  updated_colnames <- c("A375_DMSO_1","A375_DMSO_2","A375_DMSO_3",
                        "A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_1","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_2","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_3",
                        "WM793_DMSO_1","WM793_DMSO_2","WM793_DMSO_3", 
                        "WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_1","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_2","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h_3")
  colnames(NES_data2) <- updated_colnames
  
  # get the information for FOXD3 & update column and rownames
  manoela_annotation_col <- as.data.frame(log2(ntcts["ENSG00000187140",]))
  manoela_annotation_col_subset <- as.data.frame(manoela_annotation_col[col_order,])
  colnames(manoela_annotation_col_subset) <- "FOXD3"
  rownames(manoela_annotation_col_subset) <- updated_colnames
  
  manoela_annotation_col_subset2 <- manoela_annotation_col_subset
  manoela_annotation_col_subset$category <- c("A375_DMSO","A375_DMSO","A375_DMSO",
                                              "A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h",
                                              "WM793_DMSO","WM793_DMSO","WM793_DMSO", 
                                              "WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h")
  
  manoela_annotation_col_subset3 <- manoela_annotation_col_subset %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise_at(vars(FOXD3),
                 list(FOXD3 = mean)) %>% as.data.frame
  manoela_annotation_col_subset4 <- as.data.frame(transform(manoela_annotation_col_subset3, FOXD3 = as.numeric(FOXD3)))
  
  manoela_annotation_col_subset4 <- data.frame((as.numeric((manoela_annotation_col_subset3$FOXD3))))
  colnames(manoela_annotation_col_subset4) <- "FOXD3"
  rownames(manoela_annotation_col_subset4) <- t(manoela_annotation_col_subset3$category)
  
  
  annotation_colors_twolines = list(
    `Cell Line` = c(A375 = "#ff9289", WM793 = "#82B7FF")
  )
  
  
  # plot a simpler heatmap looking at averages
  # add an additional category for simplification
  add_category <- data.frame(category = c("A375_DMSO","A375_DMSO","A375_DMSO",
                                          "A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h",
                                          "WM793_DMSO","WM793_DMSO","WM793_DMSO", 
                                          "WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h","WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h"))
  NES_data3 <- cbind(t(NES_data2),(add_category))
  
  # calculate average by category & turn to dataframe 
  NES_data4 <- NES_data3 %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    summarise_at(vars(names(geneSets)),
                 list(Mean_Frequency = mean)) %>% as.data.frame
  
  # transpose, set column names, and remove category column
  NES_data5 <- as.data.frame(x = t(NES_data4), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(NES_data5) <- NES_data5["category",]
  NES_data5 <- NES_data5[!(row.names(NES_data5) %in% c("category")),]
  
  # convert to numeric
  NES_data6 <- NES_data5 %>%
    mutate_all(as.numeric)
  rownames(NES_data6) <- c("Upregulated","Downregulated")
  
  # reorder
  col_order <- c("A375_DMSO",
                 "A375_BRAFi-MEKi_72h",
                 "WM793_DMSO",
                 "WM793_BRAFi-MEKi_72h")
  
  NES_data6 <- NES_data6[,col_order]
  
  # print new heatmap
  tiago_plot <- pheatmap(NES_data6, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, 
                           labels_col = c("Untreated","Treated","Untreated","Treated"),
           annotation_col = manoela_annotation_col_subset4,
           annotation_colors = annotation_colors_twolines,
           fontsize = 12, cellwidth = 24, cellheight = 16, scale="row",
           angle_col = 315
           #main = "Gene Signature Applied to BRAFi/MEKi-Treated \n A375 and WM793 Melanoma Cell Lines"
           ) 
  
  ggsave(file.path(resultsDir3, "plot_tiago.png"), 
         tiago_plot, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300, scale = 0.8, bg = "white")
  
```
  
  
```{r tiago statistical analysis}  
  
  ## using limma to conduct DE analysis
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + dds_tiago$group)
  colnames(design) <- c("A1","A2","A3","A4","B1","B2","B3","B4","C1","C2","C3","C4")
  # it'll be the 2s and the 4s
  rownames(design) <- colnames(gbm_es)
  
  
  # generate limma
  fit <- lmFit(NES_data, design)
  #cont.matrix=makeContrasts(A2-A4, B2-B4, C2-C4
  #                          ,levels = design)
  
  cont.matrix=makeContrasts(B2-B4, C2-C4
                            ,levels = design)
  
  
  fit2=contrasts.fit(fit,cont.matrix)
  fit2=eBayes(fit2)
  results <- decideTests(fit2, p.value = 0.05)
  updated_colnames_limma <- c("A375 BRAFi-MEKi Treated v Untreated",
                         "WM793 BRAFi-MEKi Treated v Untreated")
  colnames(results) <- updated_colnames_limma
  
  
  
  stats_results <- (as.data.frame(fit2$coefficients))
  colnames(stats_results) <- updated_colnames_limma
  rownames(stats_results) <- c("UPREGULATED","DOWNREGULATED")
  
  just_stats_results <- stats_results
  colnames(just_stats_results) <- c("A375 Treated v Untreated",
                         "WM793 Treated v Untreated")
  
  
  NES_significance <- data.frame(cbind(topTable(fit2,coef=1)$adj.P.Val,
                                       topTable(fit2,coef=2)$adj.P.Val))
  NES_significance <- NES_significance %>% arrange(desc(NES_significance$X1))
  
  
  ### Convert significance cutoffs to number of asterisks
  for( fi in 1:dim(NES_significance)[1]){
    for( fj in 1:dim(NES_significance)[2]){
      if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.001){
        NES_significance[fi,fj] = 3
      } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.01) {
        NES_significance[fi,fj] = 2
      } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.05) {
        NES_significance[fi,fj] = 1
      } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] >= 0.05) {
        NES_significance[fi,fj] = 0
      }
    }
  }
  
  collapseAster <- function(numRepeat, charToRepeat = "*"){
    if (numRepeat > 0){
      return(paste(rep(charToRepeat, numRepeat), collapse = ""))    
    } else {
      return("")    
    }
  }
  
  
  just_stats_results2 = round(just_stats_results,2)
  for( fi in 1:dim(just_stats_results)[1]){
    for( fj in 1:dim(just_stats_results)[2]){
      just_stats_results2[fi,fj] = paste0(just_stats_results2[fi,fj], " ", collapseAster(NES_significance[fi,fj]))
    }
  }
  
  # update annotation values for each cell line
  annotation <- data.frame(c("A375","WM793"))
  rownames(annotation) <- t(colnames(just_stats_results))
  colnames(annotation) <- "Cell Line"
  rownames(just_stats_results) <- c("Upregulated","Downregulated")
  
  # make it into another heatmap?
  tiago_stats_plot <- pheatmap(just_stats_results,display_numbers = just_stats_results2, 
                                 labels_col = c("Treated v Untreated","Treated v Untreated"),
           cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
           #annotation_col = annotation,
           #annotation_colors = annotation_colors_twolines,
           cellwidth = 30, cellheight = 20, fontsize=8,
           angle_col = 315,
           breaks = seq(-1.1,1.1, length.out=(101)), 
           ) 
  
ggsave(file.path(resultsDir3, "tiago_stats_plot.png"), tiago_stats_plot, 
       width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300, scale = 0.8, bg = "white")
  


 
```

```{r generate_limma}
## using limma to conduct DE analysis
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + gbm_es$condition)
# colnames(design) <- c("A1","B1","B2","A2","C1","C2")
colnames(design) <- c("A1", "A2", "B1", "B2", "C1", "C2")
rownames(design) <- colnames(gbm_es)



# generate limma
fit <- lmFit(NES_data, design)
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(A1 - A2, B1 - B2, C1 - C2,
  A1 - A2 - B1 - B2 - C1 - C2,
  levels = design
)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
results <- decideTests(fit2, p.value = 0.05)
updated_colnames <- c("P:TvU", "KO1:TvU", "KO2:TvU", "PvKO:TvU")

colnames(results) <- updated_colnames
stats_results <- (as.data.frame(fit2$coefficients))
colnames(stats_results) <- updated_colnames


annotation <- data.frame(c("P:TvU", "KO1:TvU", "KO2:TvU", "PvKO:TvU"))
annotation <- data.frame(c("Parental", "KO1", "KO2", "Parental v KO1 & KO2"))
rownames(annotation) <- (c("P:TvU", "KO1:TvU", "KO2:TvU", "PvKO:TvU"))
colnames(annotation) <- "Categories"


# stats_results$fill_name <- c("UPREGULATED","DOWNREGULATED")
# stats_results <- rbind(stats_results, updated_colnames)
rownames(stats_results) <- c("UPREGULATED", "DOWNREGULATED")
just_stats_results <- stats_results
stats_results$fill_name <- c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")

stats_results2 <- as.data.frame(stats_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !(fill_name)
  )) # %>% as.data.frame

stats_results2$groups <- c("A375", "A375-KO1", "A375-KO2", "Parental-KO")


# stats_results$fill_name <- c("Upregulated","Downregulated")
stats_results <- rbind(stats_results, colnames(stats_results))

colnames(stats_results) <- updated_colnames
res <- cbind(topTable(fit2, coef = 1)$adj.P.Val, topTable(fit2, coef = 2)$adj.P.Val, topTable(fit2, coef = 3)$adj.P.Val, topTable(fit2, coef = 4)$adj.P.Val)

ggplot(data = stats_results2, aes(x = name, y = value, fill = groups)) +
  facet_wrap(~fill_name) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", position = position_dodge()) +
  theme_minimal()


# it might be better to separate out these values?
ggplot(stats_results2, aes(name, value)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = groups), stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = .5) +
  # geom_signif(data = annotation_df,
  #           aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, annotations = label, y_position = y),
  #          textsize = 3, vjust = -0.2,
  #        manual = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~fill_name) +
  ylim(NA, 1.5)


NES_significance <- data.frame(cbind(
  topTable(fit2, coef = 1)$adj.P.Val,
  topTable(fit2, coef = 2)$adj.P.Val,
  topTable(fit2, coef = 3)$adj.P.Val,
  topTable(fit2, coef = 4)$adj.P.Val
))
NES_significance <- NES_significance %>% arrange(desc(NES_significance$X1))
# so apparently the downregulated is first and then the upregulated
# really need to come up with a better version than to arrange by desc
# desc may not always be a better option


### Convert significance cutoffs to number of asterisks
for (fi in 1:dim(NES_significance)[1]) {
  for (fj in 1:dim(NES_significance)[2]) {
    if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.001) {
      NES_significance[fi, fj] <- 3
    } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.01) {
      NES_significance[fi, fj] <- 2
    } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] < 0.05) {
      NES_significance[fi, fj] <- 1
    } else if (NES_significance[fi, fj] >= 0.05) {
      NES_significance[fi, fj] <- 0
    }
  }
}

collapseAster <- function(numRepeat, charToRepeat = "*") {
  if (numRepeat > 0) {
    return(paste(rep(charToRepeat, numRepeat), collapse = ""))
  } else {
    return("")
  }
}

just_stats_results2 <- round(just_stats_results, 2)
for (fi in 1:dim(just_stats_results)[1]) {
  for (fj in 1:dim(just_stats_results)[2]) {
    print(just_stats_results[fi, fj])
    print(collapseAster(NES_significance[fi, fj]))
    just_stats_results2[fi, fj] <- paste0(just_stats_results2[fi, fj], " ", collapseAster(NES_significance[fi, fj]))
  }
}



col_labels_stats <- c("T v U", "T v U", "T v U wrt KO", "T v U", "T v U", "T v U wrt KO")

annotation <- data.frame(c(
```

# External Validation

## Generate Yang et Al Figures (UMAP + Pre & Post-Treatment)

```{r}
yang <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "yang.rds"))

# SCT --> PCA --> UMAP Workflow
yang <- RunPCA(yang)
yang <- FindNeighbors(yang, dims = 1:30)
yang <- FindClusters(yang, resolution = 0.5)
yang <- RunUMAP(yang, dims = 1:30)

# Add Module Score
for (gene_sig in names(geneSets_HUGO)) {
  # get list of genes in the gene signature
  genesig_list <- unlist(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes as a dataframe
  genesig_df <- as.data.frame(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes that will be used for the features
  features_genesig <-
    genesig_df[genesig_list %in% rownames(yang@assays$SCT), gene_sig]

  # add module score for this
  yang <- AddModuleScore(yang,
    features = list(c(features_genesig)),
    name = gene_sig
  )

  # rename the module scores to remove the "1"
  colnames(yang@meta.data) <-
    gsub(
      x = colnames(yang@meta.data),
      pattern = paste0(gene_sig, 1),
      replacement = gene_sig
    )
}


# calculate stats
yang_stats <- yang@meta.data %>%
  wilcox_test(Downregulated ~ Condition) %>%
  bind_cols(
    wilcox_effsize(yang@meta.data, Downregulated ~ Condition)
  )

yang_pval <- yang_stats$p
yang_eff <- yang_stats$effsize

# relevel factor
yang$Condition <- factor(yang@meta.data$Condition, levels = c("untreated", "treated"))

## generate plots
# UMAP Plot
yang_sctplot <- FeaturePlot(yang, reduction = "umap", features = "FOXD3")


# Set p-values and effect size for plot
pval_text <- ifelse(
  yang_pval == 0,
  "Wilcoxon p < 1e-16",
  paste0("p = ", format(yang_pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3))
)

eff_text <- paste0("Effect size r = ", round(yang_eff, 3))

yang_plot <- ggplot(yang@meta.data, aes(x = Condition, y = Downregulated, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) + # color = "black", size = 1.1) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "gray20", fill = "gray90") +
  annotate("text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = max(yang@meta.data$Downregulated, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
    label = paste(pval_text, eff_text, sep = "\n"),
    size = 5, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# print to figure for publications
ggsave(file.path(resultsDir3, "yang_sctplot.png"), yang_sctplot, width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)

ggsave(file.path(resultsDir3, "yang_plot.png"), yang_plot, width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)
```
